svg.title: Allocate $25,000 Without Confusing Reserves with Expense
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate $25,000 Without Confusing Reserves with Expense; subtitle: Four capital buckets within the $10,000–$45,000 startup range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative startup allocation totals $25,000, within the canonical $10,000–$45,000 range. Shares are 26%, 22%, 32%, and 20%. Capital allocations are not automatically current-period expenses. First-deal timing is 1–4 months; first cash collection can occur later, so maintain a dated liquidity forecast.; caption: $6,500 + $5,500 + $8,000 + $5,000 = $25,000. Release filing liquidity only for screened cases with documented fee ownership and reimbursement treatment.; stages: label: Secure intake infrastructure; value: $6,500; 26% of capital; numeric value: 6500.0; detail: Fund encrypted storage setup, role-based access, audit logging, 835 parser validation, and backup restoration testing. Use synthetic or de-identified fixtures until contracts and required business-associate arrangements cover the production data path.; label: Contracts and operating setup; value: $5,500; 22% of capital; numeric value: 5500.0; detail: Fund provider engagement terms, BAA preparation, representation scope, insurance deposits, and accounting design. Specify the incremental-cash baseline, cost deductions, refund allocation, retained share, and handling of provider-owned money.; label: Case-fee liquidity reserve; value: $8,000; 32% of capital; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Reserve cash for authorized administrative and entity fee outlays where the provider contract assigns funding responsibility. Track advances, reimbursements, losses, and actual refunds separately; a refundable deposit is not earned operator revenue.; label: Acquisition and runway reserve; value: $5,000; 20% of capital; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Fund targeted provider outreach, pilot onboarding, and a limited operating buffer. At the illustrative $5,500 monthly fixed overhead, this bucket alone covers less than one month; use staged spending, provider-funded fees, or additional capital before expanding.

text.title: Allocate $25,000 Without Confusing Reserves with Expense

rect.title: label: Secure intake infrastructure; numeric value: 6500.0; value: $6,500; 26% of capital; detail: Fund encrypted storage setup, role-based access, audit logging, 835 parser validation, and backup restoration testing. Use synthetic or de-identified fixtures until contracts and required business-associate arrangements cover the production data path.

label: Contracts and operating setup; numeric value: 5500.0; value: $5,500; 22% of capital; detail: Fund provider engagement terms, BAA preparation, representation scope, insurance deposits, and accounting design. Specify the incremental-cash baseline, cost deductions, refund allocation, retained share, and handling of provider-owned money.

label: Acquisition and runway reserve; numeric value: 5000.0; value: $5,000; 20% of capital; detail: Fund targeted provider outreach, pilot onboarding, and a limited operating buffer. At the illustrative $5,500 monthly fixed overhead, this bucket alone covers less than one month; use staged spending, provider-funded fees, or additional capital before expanding.
